title: Reflow preserved native question containers into a reference layout
steps: Inspect the reference actual paper/margins/columns/paragraph rhythm and scope its incomplete or differently ordered content.
Move intact question envelopes out of obsolete page containers. Preserve scripts, metric dimensions/baselines/margins, figure payloads/bindings and nested controls.
Apply current reference flow parameters, preserve initial secPr/colPr and review whole-question overflow.
Set requested native DocSummaryInfo title and opf:title. Save with the explicit requested HWP or HWPX format.
For HWP, require actual CFB/HWP signatures; clear/reopen the delivered file and export its PDF. Compare content/binding preservation and changed layout once.
stopWhen: Container identity or native instance ownership is unresolved.
Content or equation metrics would be altered merely to fit a page.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
